\begin{table}[t]\centering\small
\caption{\textbf{Validation of the retransmission factorization.} $p_{\mathrm{decomp}}$ is the factored estimate $p(\mathrm{post})\,p(\mathrm{payload}\mid\mathrm{post})$ (conditional from prefill); $p_{\mathrm{nat}}$ is $p(\mathrm{retransmit})$ sampled directly from $N$ natural heartbeats (security carrier, rank 0). Brackets are 95\% CIs (delta method for $p_{\mathrm{decomp}}$, Wilson for $p_{\mathrm{nat}}$). Since both rates share $p(\mathrm{post})$, their ratio is exactly that of the prefill and natural conditionals $p(\mathrm{payload}\mid\mathrm{post})$; the reported $p$ is therefore Fisher's exact test of that conditional (prefill vs natural), whose power is set by the number of natural posts (\emph{posts}), not by $N$. Large $p$ = consistent (no detectable prefill bias).}
